correctness.rationale: Reproducing kernels give exact formulas P=e^{b conjugate(d)+a conjugate(d) z} C_{a conjugate(c) z+b conjugate(c)} and Q=e^{conjugate(d)z} C_{a conjugate(c)z+b}. The explicit unitary decomposition T=e^{delta-E} U_p D_v U_q holds for every exponential-affine weighted composition with |v|<1. D_v is diagonal with entries v^n on a complete orthonormal basis; the scalar norms simplify exactly to A/(2D) and B/(2D), including the rank-one v=0 case. The difference is a Hermitian quadratic form with determinant -|a-c|^2, establishing the complete comparison and sign reversals. A separate program completed 143 supplementary finite checks; it is not used to justify infinite-dimensional conclusions.

value.rationale: This is a natural quantitative refinement of simultaneous compactness for two operator-product orientations. It determines all approximation numbers and Schatten norms, and proves a complete necessary-and-sufficient rigidity classification for uniform cross-orientation dominance, with unbounded failures in both directions when slopes differ. The exact signed quadratic-form phenomenon is substantial mathematical information not implied by qualitative ideal membership; no unrelated parameter slice or arbitrary finite table is used.
